author: The Associated Press
title: Indiana Hoosier Lotto Plus and Weather Report
text:
• The winning numbers for the "Indiana Hoosier Lotto Plus" game on Wednesday were: 16, 19, 24, 27, 33, 39.
• The weather forecast for overnight includes light rain early, remaining cloudy with showers.
• The low temperature is forecast to be 62F.
• Winds are expected from the South at 10 to 20 mph.
• There is an 80% chance of rain.
• The article was updated on April 1, 2026, at 11:14 pm.
• The article includes various website messages related to email confirmations, subscriptions, password resets, and gift purchases.
